caveats: Numbers compare exactly in OPA and as f64 in the evaluator; results can differ for integers beyond 2^53.
Equality on array- or object-valued fields compares integer and float forms of the same number as equal in OPA and as different in the evaluator.
Results reflect the evaluator's default three-valued mode; the boolean mode is not projected.

classes.adapter: an explicit target adaptation, verified against a reference implementation
classes.isomorphic: the per-policy True/False/Unknown/error result equals the DomainForge evaluator's
classes.structural: carried as data with the same shape; not evaluated
classes.unrepresentable: cannot be projected; the projection fails with REGO001

decision_contract.reason: The evaluator reports per-policy violations and has no aggregate outcome. deny: any error-severity policy is violated or fails to evaluate, or the input is malformed; escalate: otherwise, any error-severity policy is Unknown; allow: otherwise. Priority orders reasons only; the evaluator does not use it to resolve conflicts.
